answer: A new identity joining the trellis must post the same bond, so mass fake accounts become prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent locks collateral that decays by a fixed delta per epoch unless renewed. Peers also gossip a signed whisper about each agent's reputation; identities with no corroborating whisper are throttled. Attackers must fund and sustain every fake identity, making the marginal cost of one extra vote exceed its value. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
